description: This file implements the 'Cycler' class, providing methods for battery cycling operations such as rest, constant current (CC), constant voltage (CV), and combined CC-CV procedures, along with capacity testing and data management.

classes.name: slide::Cycler
classes.description: Class managing battery cycling processes including rest, CC, CV, and capacity testing.

methods.name: initialise
methods.description: Initializes the Cycler with a storage unit and an identifier.

methods.name: setDiagnostic
methods.description: Enables or disables diagnostic mode for voltage limit checks.

methods.name: writeData
methods.description: Writes current data to the storage unit.

methods.name: storeData
methods.description: Stores data points, with a check for maximum data points.

methods.name: rest
methods.description: Restores the storage unit for a specified time ignoring voltage limits, with data logging.

methods.name: setCurrent
methods.description: Sets the current in the storage unit, checking voltage limits if in diagnostic mode.

methods.name: CC
methods.description: Applies a constant current until voltage or time limit is reached.

methods.name: CV
methods.description: Applies a constant voltage until current or time limit is reached.

methods.name: CCCV
methods.description: Performs a combined CC and CV cycle.

methods.name: CCCV_with_tlim
methods.description: Performs a CC and CV cycle with a specified time limit.

methods.name: testCapacity
methods.description: Calculates the charge capacity of the connected storage unit.

methods.name: Profile
methods.description: Placeholder for profile cycling method, currently returns an unknown status.
